verdict.rationale: Rippling markets treating AI agents as identities alongside people (doc-23) and offers scoped Bearer API tokens whose access is the intersection of profile and token scopes (doc-22), which maps loosely to 'scoped agent credentials.' However, there is no concrete documented pattern for token vaulting, cross-app agent access flows, or agent-specific credential lifecycle management—just high-level marketing language and generic API auth docs. missing for 10: dedicated agent-identity documentation, token vaulting mechanism, cross-app access pattern specifics, independent/hands-on corroboration.
